default_in_repayment.text:
(a) In our opinion, the Company has not defaulted in the repayment of loans or other borrowings or in the payment of interest thereon to any lender during the year.

(b) The Company has not been declared wilful defaulter by any bank or financial institution or government or any government authority.

(c) To the best of our knowledge and belief, in our opinion, term loans availed by the Company were, applied by the Company during the year for the purposes for which the loans were obtained.

(d) On an overall examination of the financial statements of the Company, funds raised on short-term basis have, prima facie, not been used during the year for long-term purposes by the Company.

(e) On an overall examination of the financial statements of the Company, the Company has not taken any funds from any entity or person on account of or to meet the obligations of its subsidiaries.

(f) The Company has not raised loans during the year on the pledge of securities held in its subsidiaries.

fraud.text:
(a) To the best of our knowledge and according to the information and explanations given to us, no fraud by the Company and no fraud on the Company has been noticed or reported during the year.

(b) To the best of our knowledge, no report under sub-section (12) of section 143 of the Companies Act has been filed in Form ADT-4 as prescribed under rule 13 of Companies (Audit and Auditors) Rules, 2014 with the Central Government, during the year and upto the date of this report.
(c) As represented to us by the Management, there were no whistle blower complaints received by the Company during the year and up to the date of report.

timeline.summary: Croatia's HALMED issued procedural GMP non-compliance observations for Swiss Parenterals Units 1 and 2 following a March 2026 inspection.
India Ratings assigned IND AA/Stable/IND A1+ to ₹100 Cr and affirmed ₹420 Cr of bank loan facilities of Eris Therapeutics.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹756.56 Cr (+7.3% YoY), net profit to shareholders ₹281.61 Cr (+200.1% YoY).
Eris Lifesciences reported Q4 FY26 consolidated revenue of ₹757 Cr and PAT of ₹279 Cr, up 173% YoY due to a deferred tax adjustment.
Eris Lifesciences Limited shared the earnings conference call recording for Q4 FY2026 on May 20, 2026, via its website.
Eris Lifesciences Limited’s shareholders approved resolutions via remote e-voting on May 23, 2026, with Mr. Ravi Kapoor submitting the Scrutinizer’s report on May 25, 2026.
Eris Lifesciences filed the transcript of the analyst and investor call for Q4 FY26 results on May 26, 2026.
Eris Lifesciences filed the annual promoter shareholding and encumbrance disclosure under Regulation 31(4) for FY26.
Eris Lifesciences received fines totaling ₹8.50 lakh from BSE and NSE for board composition non-compliance in Q4 FY26.
Q2FY27 results (consolidated): revenue ₹892.37 Cr (+12.6% YoY), net profit to shareholders ₹183.82 Cr (+52.9% YoY).
Eris Lifesciences reports Q2FY27 revenue of ₹892 Cr, up 12.6% YoY

Recording of the earnings conference call for the unaudited consolidated and standalone financial results of the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, held on October 26, 2026, is available on the company website.
